items.raw_excerpt: Glasshouse operators in the Westland region could lose tens of millions of euros after a ban on sprinklers comes into force on Wednesday. The glasshouse industry has not been exempted from the ban, which has been imposed by the Delfland water authority as an anti-drought measure. All sluice gates in the region have been closed to protect drinking water from being contaminated by saltwater from the sea. Inspectors will check if companies are complying with the ban on using water...
items.summary_en: Greenhouse operators in the Westland region could lose tens of millions of euros. A new sprinkler ban starts Wednesday to fight drought. Sluice gates are closed to stop saltwater from ruining drinking water.

items.raw_excerpt: New statistics show that last month was one of the hottest, driest and sunniest months on record for Ireland.

items.raw_excerpt: "God arbejdslyst" is a term which you'll likely come across on an almost daily basis in Denmark. Ever wondered what it means?
